Intro Dete-
June 15, 2025

ORDINANCE
BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:
SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all the B1-1, Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 7-K in the area bounded by:
The public alley next north of and parallel to West Fullerton Avenue; a line 159.54 feet
west of and parallel to North Kilbourn Avenue; West Fullerton Avenue; and a line 184.54
feet west of and parallel to North Kilbourn Avenue
to those of a C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. _ This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due publication.

Common Property Address: 4516 West Fullerton Avenue
